senses.gloss:
खश खश,
 I. m.
 1. pl. The name of a people, Man. 10, 47.
 2. The son of an outcast Kṣatriya, Man. 10, 22 (written with स् instead of श्).
 II. f. शा (and सा), A proper name, Hariv. 169; 11521.
खस खस, खसा खसा, see खश.
खशरीरिन् खशरीरिन्, i. e. ख-शरीर + इन्, [] adj., f. इणी, Having an ætherial form, Man. 4, 243.
† खष् खष्, i. 1, Par. To hurt.
